_status: PROVISIONAL. Every value tagged 'provisional' is a placeholder for a sweep, NOT a cited or approved parameter. Replace it from Appendix C (docs/nlmin_derivation.md), Component 1, or supervisor decision before reporting results.

nlmin_derivation.coal_source: CEB LTGEP 2025-2044, Table 2.7, p. 2-10 (Lakvijaya: 3 x 270 MW used for studies; minimum operating level 150 MW)
nlmin_derivation.mini_hydro_source: CEB LTGEP 2025-2044, p. 2-3: mini hydro plants are typically non-dispatchable run-of-river

scenario_years._note: CEB Long Term Generation Expansion Plan 2025-2044 (LTGEP), base case. Used by build_grid_scenario.ltgep_scenario.
scenario_years.installed_source: LTGEP Table 2.1, p. 2-1 (solar 953 MW incl. 815 MW rooftop; wind 103.5 CEB + 163 IPP); must-take = mini hydro 419 + biomass/other 54 (Table 2.3, p. 2-7)
scenario_years.additions_2024_source: assumption: the LTGEP plan starts in 2025; 2024 solar additions set to the plan's 2025 rate (150 MW embedded + 50 MW grid). Multipliers move by < 0.15 for 0-400 MW
scenario_years.additions_source: LTGEP Table E3, p. E-7: solar = distribution-connected embedded + grid-connected; must-take = mini hydro + biomass
scenario_years.net_generation_source: LTGEP Table 3.3 Base Demand Forecast, p. 3-11
scenario_years.not_modelled: planned battery storage (LTGEP Table E3: 105 MW by 2026, 405 MW by 2029) and new gas plants' minimum loading; risk is before storage

central.nlmin_source: derived (scripts/derive_nlmin.py): 2 coal units x 150 MW minimum (LTGEP Table 2.7) + 217 MW major hydro kept online (observed 2024 practice); pending CEB review
central.snsp_source: CEB LTGEP 2025-2044 planning limit, pp. 7-7, 7-13, 10-14; 2024 operation never exceeded 46%
central.scenario_year_source: LTGEP base case; multipliers derived by build_grid_scenario.ltgep_scenario
central.sessions_per_day_source: provisional: national public sessions/day; replace with Component 1 fleet scenario
central.station_source: provisional: 50 kW site connection shared by its charge points

sessions.source_note: parametric = uncalibrated uniform draws (fallback). Set to 'gmm' with --acn-json once ACN-Data is downloaded.

evaluation.day_sample: one schedulable day per ISO week; week k prefers weekday k mod 7 so weekends are represented
evaluation.risk_days: every schedulable day with curtailment risk in the central scenario year (absorption comparison and weight trade-off)
evaluation.sweep_days: the same days as the central comparison
